items.label: Sturdy Support for Heavy Vines
items.value: Featuring a tapered, wide-bottom frame with iron-reinforced pillars, this trellis resists bending and supports heavy crops like cucumbers and tomatoes. Textured side rails allow vines to climb naturally without extra ties

items.label: Open Ladder Design for Easy Harvest & Pruning
items.value: Our open ladder-style structure lets you reach every fruit, leaf, and stem with ease. Whether you’re picking fresh produce, trimming overgrowth, or applying fertilizer. Its open ladder design ensures easy access for harvesting, pruning, and checks. The unobstructed design saves time and effort—no more struggling through tangled branches

items.label: Pointed Stakes & Secure Snap Connections
items.value: Equipped with sharp, heavy-duty pointed stakes that insert firmly into soil, the trellis stays stable even in windy conditions or when supporting mature, fruit-laden vines. The tight-fitting snap connections ensure all parts lock securely together, preventing wobbling or loosening over time

items.label: DIY Adjustable Height
items.value: Fit Different Plant Growth Stages, Customize the height to match your plants’ growth needs! The modular design allows you to adjust the trellis height by adding or removing sections, making it ideal for everything from young seedlings to tall, mature vines. Whether you’re growing short beans or tall tomatoes, this adjustable trellis adapts to your garden’s changing needs, maximizing vertical growing space

items.label: Versatile & Space-Saving
items.value: Measuring 63.8” H (162cm) with a 14.8” bottom width (37.5cm) and 4.7” top width (12cm), this trellis fits perfectly in standard US raised beds and in-ground gardens. Beyond vegetables, it’s also great for flowering vines like clematis and honeysuckle, adding vertical interest to patios, decks, or balconies
